FRONTIER / PROJECT-DRIVE

Fresh CPU rendering & vehicle evidence

These are new C++ CPU renders and real production-code dynamics traces, not AI images or Vulkan screenshots. ReSTIR RT, SDF GI + raster, and GI-off raster are separate routes. The SDF picture uses the real persistent local fields, but its one-bounce lighting is a reference only: it does not validate GPU cards, appearance, frame times or AMD device loss. The ReSTIR reference implements DI reuse with a one-bounce GI continuation, not the GPU GI reservoir/atmosphere pipeline. The current CPU raster has a simpler sun/environment treatment than the GPU resolve and looks darker here.

Energy plots cover chassis kinetic and gravitational potential energy only, not full tyre/strut stored energy. All exported body/force/energy trace values are compared bit-for-bit across repeats on this compiler/host; this is not cross-platform determinism.

F8 ejects into free flight without stopping simulation. F8 again repossesses the same vehicle; held/captured presses never repeat. Stop restores the editor camera.
